title.en: Absolute maxima and minima and applications

heading.en: The biggest box from one sheet

hook.en: Cut equal squares from the corners of a sheet and fold up the sides to make an open box. Cut too little and the box is flat; cut too much and it is thin. Calculus finds the perfect cut.

title.en: Find absolute extrema on a closed interval

say.en: Cut equal squares from the corners of a sheet and fold up the sides to make an open box. Cut too little and the box is flat; cut too much and it is thin. Calculus finds the perfect cut. In this lesson: Find absolute extrema on a closed interval.
Solve word problems on maxima and minima.

body.en: A continuous function on a closed interval $[a, b]$ always has an *absolute* maximum and an absolute minimum. To find them, evaluate $f$ at every critical point inside $(a, b)$ and at the end points $a$ and $b$; the largest value is the absolute maximum and the smallest is the absolute minimum.
body.kn: [a, b] ಮೇಲಿನ ಸಂತತ ಫಲನಕ್ಕೆ ನಿರಪೇಕ್ಷ ಗರಿಷ್ಠ ಮತ್ತು ಕನಿಷ್ಠ ಇರುತ್ತವೆ. ಎಲ್ಲ ನಿರ್ಣಾಯಕ ಬಿಂದುಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಅಂತ್ಯ ಬಿಂದುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ f ನ ಬೆಲೆ ಕಂಡುಹಿಡಿದು ಹೋಲಿಸಿ.

problem.en: Find the absolute maximum and minimum of f(x) = 2x³ − 15x² + 36x + 1 on [1, 5].

answer.en: Absolute max 56 at x = 5; absolute min 24 at x = 1

narration.en: Let us solve this together. Find the absolute maximum and minimum of f(x) = 2x³ − 15x² + 36x + 1 on [1, 5].

say.en: Let us solve this together. Find the absolute maximum and minimum of fx equals 2x cubed minus 15x squared plus 36x plus 1 on [1, 5].
f′x equals 6x minus 2x minus 3: critical points 2 and 3.
f1 equals 24, f2 equals 29, f3 equals 28, f5 equals 56.
Compare the four values.
So the answer is Absolute max 56 at x equals 5; absolute min 24 at x equals 1.

problem.en: Find two positive numbers whose sum is 24 and whose product is as large as possible.

steps.en: Let the numbers be x and 24 − x; P = x(24 − x) = 24x − x².
P′ = 24 − 2x = 0 at x = 12; P″ = −2 < 0, a maximum.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. Find two positive numbers whose sum is 24 and whose product is as large as possible.

say.en: Let us solve this together. Find two positive numbers whose sum is 24 and whose product is as large as possible.
Let the numbers be x and 24 - x; P equals x(24 - x) equals 24x - x squared.
P′ = 24 minus 2x equals 0 at x equals 12; P″ = minus 2 is less than 0, a maximum.
The numbers are 12 and 12, product 144.
So the answer is 12 and 12.
